incident-bot: [PAGER] HIGH - anomalous kv cache growth + continuous-batch storm in prod-us-east-1 runtime
incident-bot: alert_id=INC-1845123456 service=runtime-kv-cache metric=kv_cache.entries change=+1034%
alex (oncall): I'm on it. seeing 95p spike and eviction lag. checking nodes
alex (oncall): top-line: KV entry count jumped, p95 latency from ~60ms to ~800ms across the pool
priya (ml-eng): fyi I noticed a cluster of traces with speculative decoding enabled where draft tokens never reconciled with final target - lots of draft/target mismatch logs
sam (runtime): sample error: ```ERROR kv_cache: draft_target_mismatch ctx=0x7a1b sample=998 draft_len=6 target_len=2 seq_hash=0x1f4b``` . Also many short writes from continuous-batch path repeating similar prefix keys
mia (sre): some nodes (node-e5) showing continuous growth, memory pressure rising. eviction loop seems to be running but not reclaiming these short-prefix entries fast enough
alex (oncall): hypothesis: speculative decoding creates temporary draft prefixes; current cache key includes draft length/namespace so each speculative attempt writes unique entries -> prefix churn -> explosion when many small continuous batches are used
priya (ml-eng): confirming: our KV key includes prefix tokens as-is. if speculative draft differs from eventual target the cache entries are orphaned. high write rate + many draft variants = multiplicative growth
sam (runtime): immediate mitigations proposed: 1) disable speculative decoding at router for affected pool 2) tighten continuous_batch config (smaller max_batch_size and lower max_delay_ms) 3) temporarily increase eviction aggressiveness or restart runtime processes to drop cache
alex (oncall): I'm flipping a router flag to disable speculative decoding for pool prod-us-east-1-a now: ```runbook flag set pool:prod-us-east-1-a speculative_decoding=false --note="INC-1845123456 temporary"```
ops-bot: flag change accepted, rolling to 6 nodes in pool prod-us-east-1-a
ops-bot: rollout progress: 6/6 nodes updated
alex (oncall): spec_decode disabled. KV growth rate trending down within 45s
mia (sre): applying quick config patch to reduce continuous batch amplification:
PATCH /api/v1/pools/prod-us-east-1-a/config
{"continuous_batch.max_batch_size":"6","continuous_batch.max_delay_ms":"10"}
sam (runtime): issuing a rolling restart of runtime deployment to clear stale entries on a few pods: ```kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime-pool-prod-us-east-1-a -n runtime --max-unavailable=1```
jordan (support): checking customer impact - CS dashboard shows ~4 enterprise customers affected with higher latency from 1845123412 to ~1845123520 (~12 minutes). notifying customers now
jordan (support): sent status: "We’ve applied mitigations to address increased inference latency. Monitoring closely and will follow up with root cause." :thumbsup:
alex (oncall): after mitigations p95 down to ~180-220ms, p99 improving. KV entry count reduced ~70% from peak
priya (ml-eng): diagnostic query shows most new entries have small draft prefix lengths (len 3-7). this matches draft churn theory
priya (ml-eng): suggested follow-ups: - change cache key normalization to ignore speculative-only token markers OR write speculative cache to separate namespace so main cache isn't polluted - add unit/integration test simulating draft/target divergence and verify cache stability
sam (runtime): runtime actions: - add heuristic to avoid inserting >N unique draft variants per request/session - make eviction adapt to short-prefix write storms - add metric for new_entries_per_request and alert on anomalous spikes
mia (sre): primary mitigations done. setting incident state to mitigated but keeping watch. handoff to me for next 12h. Runbook link: https://playbook/internal/incidents/1845123456
mia (sre): follow-ups I'll own: - verify safe re-enable of speculative decoding on canary, block re-enable if continuous_batch.max_batch_size > 12 - create alert for draft-prefixed-entry ratio > 0.15 - coordinate with ML/runtime on cache key change and an integration test
alex (oncall): assigning postmortem to priya + sam. suggested RCA title: "Speculative decoding draft churn caused KV cache blowup under continuous batching"
priya (ml-eng): I'll draft RCA, include timeline, traces, config diffs, and test proposals
ops-bot: incident INC-1845123456 state=mitigated assigned_to=mia next_update=+2h
mia (sre): handoff note: if we see any re-acceleration of KV writes, I will trigger rollback to disable continuous_batch globally in region and/or re-disable speculative decoding
jordan (support): created customer follow-up messages and closed immediate CS loop. will wait for RCA before detailed postmortem message to customers
alex (oncall): thanks team. adding logs/traces to incident tracker and will follow up on timeline tomorrow
incident-bot: [NOTE] incident created INC-1845123456 severity=high impact=partial-outage window=~12min
